div.head: Cn 1018 23
div.ab: And fyrdunga eac swa á þonne þearf sy. for gemǽnelicre neode.
and fyrdunga eac swa a þonne þearf sy, for gemænelicre neode.
And military service also [should be undertaken] for the common need, whenever it is required.
and also the provisioning of the army as the need arises, for the common good.
